headline: The Desk is now a real, source-bound News product with coherent human and agent discovery; release is held honestly because Obelisk registered production but not stable staging.

items.title: The Desk graduated from simulation to primary-source reporting
items.insight: A deterministic real-day corpus replaces the fictional preview. Two stories preserve facts, sources, persona stance, heat, and dated predictions without a runtime model call.

items.title: Humans and agents discover the same News surface
items.insight: The Studio header dropdown, footer, sitemap, JSON Feed 1.1, agents.json, and llms surfaces all derive from the real corpus. Publication is a coherent contract rather than one hidden page.

items.title: A simulated edition can no longer become public by accident
items.insight: Simulation is validation-only and rebuilds accept only simulated:false days. The old simulated pages, cards, and proof images were retired.

items.title: Every News route was reviewed across every theme and viewport
items.insight: The hub and both stories were captured in seven themes at desktop and mobile sizes; accessibility and actual dropdown navigation were exercised separately.

items.title: Obelisk registration is measured per environment
items.insight: The production callback returns the expected redirect while stable staging returns redirect-not-registered. The website can now explain exactly what was registered without coupling News to identity.
items.evidence: api/obelisk-redirect-readiness.json · production override probe · two tenant-negative controls

honestyLedger.title: No News/Obelisk product coupling
honestyLedger.why: News is independently complete; Obelisk only gates the shared release architecture.

honestyLedger.title: No staging bypass
honestyLedger.why: The exact staging callback is unregistered, so the candidate was not uploaded or promoted.

honestyLedger.title: No partial-suite authority
honestyLedger.why: The final 283-command suite ran from step one after all generated drift was repaired.

followUps: Retain production callback and register the exact stable-staging callback
Deploy and verify the exact News candidate on stable staging
Complete one founder provider journey and promote only after the full ceremony passes
Add a News corrections and reviewed-cadence receipt
blockers: Exact candidate lacks staging and SHA-bound CI proof
Production still serves 4a72961d and News returns 404

silDelta.note: Product and automation depth improved; one point reflects that a finished News candidate is not yet visitor-visible and two reflect incomplete environment coherence.
